welcome.localStoreDesc: Data doesn't go to the cloud and stays on the device.
welcome.hwProtectDesc: Secrets are securely protected in the vault using your computer's physical TPM 2.0 chip.
welcome.subtitle: Local secure vault for technical secrets
capabilities.tpmOk: Hardware Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider is available. Vaultisor will create a non-exportable TPM key.
capabilities.tpmMissing: Hardware TPM provider is not confirmed. Windows Hello for vault will be unavailable.
capabilities.dpapiOk: Available. Ties data to your Windows account. It does not allow a short PIN — that is possible only with TPM 2.0.
capabilities.dpapiMissing: Unavailable. Without TPM and DPAPI, secrets cannot be reliably protected.
capabilities.helloTpmOk: Windows Hello can be an additional check after the Vaultisor PIN.
capabilities.helloTpmMissing: Hello is set up, but without a hardware TPM provider, vault will remain on PIN.
capabilities.helloMissing: System PIN or Windows biometrics is not set up.
capabilities.title: System Capabilities
capabilities.desc: Vaultisor checks hardware TPM provider and Windows Hello before creating a vault.
capabilities.cannotProtectDesc: There is no TPM 2.0 or DPAPI on this system — Vaultisor will not be able to securely bind the key to the device. Usage is not recommended. Enable TPM in BIOS or use a Windows account with DPAPI.
capabilities.tpmMissingTitle: TPM 2.0 not found — a master password is required
capabilities.tpmMissingDesc: Without a TPM, sign-in is protected only by a master password: set one of at least 15 characters (any characters, a whole phrase works). A short PIN is unavailable — there is no hardware key to protect it. With TPM 2.0, a PIN of 11 or more digits, or 11 or more letters and digits, is enough.
helloStep.title: Windows Hello
helloStep.desc: Stronger sign-in: after your Vaultisor PIN, Windows verifies you once more — with your face, fingerprint or system PIN.
helloStep.notAvailDesc: System PIN or Windows biometrics is not set up on the device. Vaultisor can be used via PIN, and Hello can be enabled later.
helloStep.tpmNotAvailDesc: Windows Hello is set up, but the hardware Microsoft Platform Crypto Provider is not ready. Hello-unlock for vault will not be enabled; the main PIN remains working.
helloStep.useHelloDesc: After your Vaultisor PIN, Windows will also ask for Windows Hello. Your Windows PIN and your Vaultisor PIN are separate factors. When enabling it, Windows shows two windows: saving the passkey and a test sign-in that proves the key works.
stepPin.createPassDesc: Soft-Sealing: requires a strong password of at least {{min}} characters.
stepPin.confirmPassDesc: Enter the master password again to confirm.
stepPin.savePassHint: Save this password in a safe place (phone password manager). Without it, access can only be restored via Shamir recovery shares.
stepPin.createPinAlnumDesc: PIN is the main way to unlock Vaultisor. Letters and numbers, from {{min}} characters.
stepPin.createPinDigitDesc: PIN is the main way to unlock Vaultisor. {{min}}–{{max}} digits.
stepRecovery.copyCSuccess: Part C copied — paste it as a 'secure note'
stepRecovery.saveCError: Failed to save Part C file
stepRecovery.failedDesc: Backend returned an error when creating the vault. Files rolled back, you can try again.
stepRecovery.failedHint:
The log is written only if you start Vaultisor with the VAULTISOR_DIAG=1 variable — it then appears in the vault/logs folder next to the program.
Close the app and start it again — onboarding will begin from scratch.
stepRecovery.title: Recovery
stepRecovery.desc: The recovery key is split into two parts, B and C. Access can be restored only with both parts together — nothing is stored on this device. Keep the parts apart.
stepRecovery.savePartsEnabledDesc: Recommended. Allows you to restore access if the PIN is lost.
stepRecovery.savePartsDisabledDesc: Without parts B and C, if the PIN is lost, access to secrets will be lost forever.
stepRecovery.disabledWarning: Recovery is disabled. If you forget your PIN, the vault will be inaccessible.
stepRecovery.partBDesc: Save the file to a USB drive.
stepRecovery.partCDesc: Store Share C separately from the USB containing Share B.
lock.pinMinDigits: PIN is no shorter than {{min}} digits
lock.passMinChars: Password is no shorter than {{min}} characters
lock.enhancedHello: Windows Hello is required after the Vaultisor PIN
recoveryFlow.twoSharesRequired: Both recovery parts are required — B and C
recoveryFlow.success: Access restored. Log in with your new PIN.
recoveryFlow.deviceMismatchDesc: The vault was created on another device or for another Windows account. Enter both recovery parts — B and C.
recoveryFlow.forgotPinDesc: Enter both recovery parts — B and C. One part is not enough, even on this device.
recoveryFlow.tamperedDesc: The vault metadata failed its integrity check, or an imported copy would have weakened this device's protection (switched Windows Hello off, brought back an old PIN). Access is possible only through recovery: enter both parts — B and C.
recoveryFlow.noTpmDesc: This device has no TPM 2.0 — set a master password of at least 15 characters (any characters are allowed, including spaces).
recoveryFlow.sharesSame: Parts B and C must be different
vault.emptyWebDesc: Add your first website login/password — they are stored separately from project secrets.
vault.emptyRecordsDesc: Create your first record to save an API key, token, or other secret.
recordEdit.revealError: Failed to decrypt field. Previous value will not be overwritten unless changed.
recordEdit.commentPlaceholder: Note text: anything for yourself — explanations, links, instructions.
recordEdit.revealFailedWarn: Field could not be decrypted. The entered value will replace the previous one.
recordView.authHint: Copying and viewing — under Windows Hello. After confirmation, it won't ask again for 1 minute.
recordView.noFields: There are no fields in this record yet
recordView.deleteDesc: Record '<accent>{{name}}</accent>' and all its fields will be permanently deleted.
recordView.weakHint: the password is too simple or too short (under 8 characters)
settings.title: Settings
settings.footer:
Vaultisor{{version}} — no network, no telemetry.
Proognev © 2026. All rights reserved.
settings.disableDesc: Deletes the recovery envelope: parts B and C will no longer open this vault. ⚠️ Backups made earlier still open with these parts — to rule that out too, destroy parts B and C.
settingsAutolock.title: Auto-lock
settingsClipboard.title: Clear clipboard
settingsClipboard.desc: After the specified time, the copied secret is cleared from the clipboard.
settingsSecurity.title: Security
settingsSecurity.authDescEnabled: Request Windows Hello before copying and showing a secret. After confirmation — it won't ask again for 1 minute.
settingsSecurity.authDescDisabled: Requires Windows Hello to be enabled — it confirms access to the secret.
settingsSecurity.helloDescEnabled: Enhanced sign-in: Vaultisor PIN plus Windows Hello. Windows may offer face, fingerprint, or the Windows Hello PIN.
settingsSecurity.helloDescDisabled: Disabled. Only the main Vaultisor PIN is used.
settingsSecurity.helloHint: Windows Hello is checked after the Vaultisor PIN.
settingsSecurity.helloKeyWarning: The Windows Hello key will appear in Windows Settings as vaultisor.app. If you delete it there, access will only be possible through recovery!
generatorScreen.title: Secret generator
generatorScreen.alnumOnlyHint: For systems that reject special characters, and for .env, YAML and connection strings — $ # & ; < > | break the syntax there.
generatorScreen.retentionNotice: Generated values are stored encrypted and removed automatically after {{hours}} h. Save anything you need long-term as a record.
settingsGenerator.title: Secret generator
settingsGenerator.desc: A separate screen for generating passwords and keys. Generated values are stored encrypted and removed after a day.
settingsRecovery.title: Emergency Recovery
settingsRecovery.desc: Shamir's scheme: the recovery key is split into parts B and C. Together they restore access if the PIN is lost; one part opens nothing.
settingsRecovery.configuredDesc: Parts B and C are saved. Create a new set if needed — the previous one stops working.
settingsRecovery.notConfiguredDesc: Without parts B and C, recovery is impossible if the PIN is lost.
settingsRecovery.regeneratedDesc: Old recovery parts have been replaced. Save the new B and C.
settingsRecovery.partC: Part C — QR / in phone passwords
settingsBackup.restoreConfirm:
Restore from this copy?

Current data on this PC will be REPLACED with the contents of the copy. The application will restart, and login will be required: this device's PIN (if the copy is from it) or Shamir shares recovery (if the copy is from another PC).

Continue?
settingsBackup.restored: Data restored. PIN, Windows Hello, FIDO2 and recovery are unchanged. Restarting…
settingsBackup.title: Backup
settingsBackup.desc: Saves an encrypted copy of the vault to the selected folder. Specify a cloud client folder (Yandex.Disk/Dropbox/OneDrive) — the copy will go to the cloud. On the same PC, the copy is restored using the device's PIN. For transfer to another PC/laptop, Shamir shares will be required. The last 3 copies are kept.
settingsBackup.scheduleHint: The schedule triggers on unlock if the time has come (the application must be opened for auto-backup).
settingsBackup.restoreDesc: Will replace current data on this PC with the contents of the selected .vault. For a copy from another PC, login after restore is via Shamir shares.
settingsBackup.importBrowserDesc: Imports saved accounts from CSV files of Chrome, Opera, Edge, Yandex into the 'Websites' section.
settingsBackup.importSuccess: Imported entries: {{count}}. Passwords added to 'Websites' section.
settingsBackup.importPartial: Imported {{imported}} of {{total}}, {{rejected}} not imported. Keep the source file: it holds the only copy of those passwords.
settingsBackup.deleteCsvDesc: The imported CSV file sits on disk in plain unencrypted text. It is strongly recommended to securely overwrite and delete it.
settingsBackup.deleteCsvSuccess: Source CSV file successfully shredded and deleted
generator.title: Value generator
pinRules.passphraseTooShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters
pinRules.secretBlank: The secret cannot consist of spaces only
pinRules.secretSingleChar: Secret is too simple (one repeated character)
pinRules.secretFewDistinct: Secret is too simple (fewer than {{min}} different characters)
settingsSecurity.fido2Desc: Connect one or multiple hardware authenticators (Rutoken MFA, YubiKey, etc.) for independent unlocking
settingsSecurity.fido2OpenWindowsSetup: Set up the security key in Windows
settingsSecurity.fido2UnbindConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to unbind key "{{name}}"? This authenticator will no longer be able to unlock Vaultisor.
settingsSecurity.fido2KeyNamePrompt: Enter key name (e.g. Rutoken MFA, YubiKey 5):
settingsSecurity.passwordHistoryDesc: Save up to 10 previous versions of modified passwords
settingsSecurity.changePinDesc: The master key itself does not change — only its wrapper is re-encrypted. Records and existing backups stay valid.
securityConfirm.title: Confirm action
securityConfirm.action.changePin: Changing the PIN requires your current PIN.
securityConfirm.action.enableHello: Enabling Windows Hello requires your PIN. Windows then shows two windows: saving the passkey and a test sign-in that proves the key works.
securityConfirm.action.disableHello: Disabling Windows Hello requires your PIN and Windows Hello.
securityConfirm.action.enableStepUp: Enabling copy confirmation requires your PIN and Windows Hello.
securityConfirm.action.disableStepUp: Disabling copy confirmation requires your PIN and Windows Hello.
securityConfirm.action.bindFido: Binding a FIDO2 key requires your PIN. The token will then ask for its PIN and a touch twice: to register and for a test sign-in.
securityConfirm.action.unbindFido: Unbinding a FIDO2 key requires your PIN.
securityConfirm.action.regenerateRecover: New recovery parts give full access to the vault. Confirm with your PIN.
securityConfirm.action.restoreBackup: Restoring a backup replaces your records. Confirm with your PIN.
securityConfirm.action.changeBackupDirec: Changing the backup folder requires your PIN.
settingsRecovery.pendingDesc: Saving parts B and C was not confirmed. Create new parts and save both — the previous ones will stop working.
settingsRecovery.acknowledgeError: Could not confirm that the parts were saved
recoveryPending.title: Save your recovery parts
recoveryPending.desc: The previous set of parts B and C was never confirmed — it may not have reached you. It has been revoked; a new set is below. Save both parts and press “Done”.
lock.rollbackDesc: The records or website-password files are older than the last confirmed state: they were replaced with earlier copies. Changes made after those copies are missing.
lock.rollbackWarning: If you did not restore these files yourself, do not continue: they may have been swapped. Continue only deliberately — this data will become current.
lock.rollbackNeedsPin: The data is older than expected. Sign in with your PIN to see the details and decide whether to continue.
